title: Quick Polish Epoisses Wrap
description: A dairy-free friendly Polish dish featuring epoisses cheese, wrapped in a corn husk, perfect for a quick snack or lunch
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium heat
In a mortar, pound the caraway seeds and black pepper until fragrant
Add the softened epoisses cheese to the mortar and mix until well combined
Brush the corn husks with olive oil and warm them on the grill for 30 seconds
Spoon about 2 oz of the epoisses mixture onto the center of each corn husk
Top the epoisses with a spoonful of sauerkraut and a sprinkle of salt
Fold the bottom edge of the corn husk up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly
Serve the wraps warm, with additional sauerkraut on the side if desired
